author: Bobby Grayson
description: Errors across iterations: by_contra missing (no Mathlib), cases pattern arity, subst replacing a def-valued pid, List.count on singletons not reduced by default simp, match on srv catch-all not reducing without cases on the Option. None were about the invariant, which the bounded model check had already validated.
title: Proof cost driver was not the protocol but Lean plumbing: if-then-else on pids, singleton List.count, and subst renaming. A tactic that normalises Step.chars output would cut the proof in half
